conductingBody: British Council, IDP: IELTS Australia & Cambridge University Press & Assessment

examPattern.mode: 4-Skill Assessment (Listening, Academic Reading, Academic Writing, Face-to-Face Speaking)
examPattern.totalMarks: Band 0 to 9 Scale (Half-band reporting across all 4 skills)

domains.name: Listening (30 Minutes, 40 Questions) & Academic Reading (60 Minutes, 40 Questions)
topics: 4 recorded monologues and conversations across social and university contexts
3 long academic texts from journals/books testing skimming, logical argument, and writer opinion

domains.name: Academic Writing (60 Minutes) & Speaking (11-14 Minutes)
topics: Task 1 (150 words, 20 min): Visual chart/graph/process synthesis; Task 2 (250 words, 40 min): Discursive academic essay
Part 1 Introduction, Part 2 Individual Long Turn (Cue Card), Part 3 Two-Way Abstract Discussion
